<head-word>טַוְורָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced., cmp. b. h. צוּר) 
<italic>mount, mountain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Ex. III, 12 (Y. טוורא). Targ. Y. Gen. XXIII, 2; a. fr.—Ḥull. 7
<sup>b</sup>, v. גְּבַהּ. Sabb. 152
<sup>a</sup> ט'תלג a mountain of snow (my head is white). Gen. R. s. 32, v. בְּרַךְ; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. טוּרִין, טוּרַיָּא, טוּרֵי, טַוְו'</plural-form>. Targ. Job. IX, 5. Targ. Deut. XI, 11; a. fr.—Gen. R. l. c. אי מט' רמיא if it belongs among the high mountains; a. e.—[Sabb. 98
<sup>b</sup> כי טירין, v. טָרִיז.]—טור מלכא (h. הר המלך) 
<italic>King’s Mountain</italic>, ט' שמעון 
<italic>Mount Simeon</italic>. Gitt. 55
<sup>b</sup>. Y. Taan. IV, 69
<sup>a</sup>; Lam. R. to II, 2 (v. Neub. Géogr. p. 41; p. 267).—ט' פרזלא 
<italic>Iron Mount</italic>. Targ. Y. Num. XXXIV, 3.—For other compounds, v. respective determinants.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>royal wardrobe, armory</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 56

<entry id="I00222">
<head-word>טוּרְזַיָּנָא, </head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>treasury-office, armory</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 56
<sup>a</sup> אפתחא דריש ט' (Ar. טרזיא, v. preced.) at the entrance of the chief treasury; [prob. to be read: דבי ט', דריש having come in by tautography from the suceeding ריש טורזיא.]—B. Bath. 8
<sup>a</sup> לשורא … ולטר' וכ' (Ms. F. טורדינא, Alf. Ms. טורדיתא) for the maintenance of the town-wall, the horse-guard and the armory even orphans must contribute.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (sub. ריש) 
<italic>superintendent of the armory</italic> or 
<italic>treasury</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 80
<sup>a</sup> ההוא ט' וכ' (ed. Sonc. טורזיינא) there was a (gentile) superintendent that lived in the neighborhood &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="I00223">
<head-word>טוֹרַח</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">טֹרַח; טָרַח)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>toil, labor, trouble, painstaking preparations</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 153
<sup>a</sup> כלום … בלא ט' is there a banquet without visible preparation?; (Koh. R. to IX, 8 הֶטְרֵחַ). M. Kat. 8
<sup>b</sup> מפני הט' on account of the labor (connected with preparing the wedding). Y. Pes. X, 37
<sup>d</sup> top מה הט' … מטריחים וכ' what is all that trouble for to which you put us &c.?; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. טָרְחוֹת</plural-form>. Ber. 58
<sup>a</sup> כמה ט' טרח וכ' to how much trouble did the host go &c.; (Y. ib. IX, 13
<sup>c</sup> כמה טורח). Lev. R. s. 1 משה עסוק בט' וכ' Moses (like an 
<italic>agoranomos</italic>) was engaged in the (dietary) affairs of Israel. Gen. R. s. 94 ט' נפש אחת the troubles of providing for one soul.—V. טַרְחוּת a. טִרְחָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>טְרוּטִינִי, </head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>,
<pos> f.</pos> (trutina, τρυτάνη, prob. of Semit.</definition>
<notes> origin, cmp. טְרָא) 
<italic>balance, steel-yard</italic>. Sifra K’dosh. Par. 3, ch. VIII במשקל זו טרי' ‘in weight’ (Lev. XIX, 35) that means the trutina. Sabb. 81
<sup>a</sup> וכי ט' יכניס shall a (gold) balance be brought in (to weigh accurately)?; Men. 87
<sup>b</sup>. B. Kam. 119
<sup>a</sup>. B. Bath. 89
<sup>a</sup> ט' (for weighing gold), contrad. to מאזנים. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 5.—Y. Shek. VI, end, 50
<sup>b</sup> כמין ט' arranged like a steel-yard. Sot. 34
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to מוֹט, Num. XIII, 23) ט' וט' דט' a combination of balancing poles (for four couples of carriers); Y. ib. VII, 21
<sup>d</sup> bot. טוּרְטיּרִין several 
<pgbrk id="pg527" />poles (each carried by two); ט' וטוּרְטוּרֵי טרוטורין a combination &c.—
<plural-form>Pl. טוּרְטָנִין</plural-form>. B. Kam. l. c. Ms. R. 2 (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. טוּחַ I) 
<italic>to cover with a cohesive substance, to polish</italic> (with a fatty matter); 
<italic>to besmear, soil, pollute</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 30
<sup>b</sup>; Zeb. 95
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. אין טָשִׁין וכ' one must not polish the stove with &c. Tosef. B. Kam. IX, 31 [in a misplaced passage, belonging after שבידיו; read:] הרָק כנגד פני חבירו וטָשׁ פניו (ref. to Is. L, 6
<sup>b</sup>) who spat into or besmeared his neighbor’s face; (cmp. Mish. ib. VIII, 6; Sifra Emor Par. 14, ch. XX).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pilpel.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>טִשְׁטֵשׁ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (fr. טָשַׁשׁ) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make viscid, soften</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 22
<sup>b</sup> מְטַשְׁטְשִׁין את הארץ (the heavy rains) make the soil muddy and it yields no fruit; Yalk. Lev. 671.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
